own_site_check: mochareignstudios.com does not resolve DNS (verified in discovery). Instagram bio external_url points only to the Booksy booking subdomain (mochareignnaturalhairstudioboutique.booksy.com), which is a platform subdomain, not a proprietary website. No independent domain found in Booksy JSON-LD or Facebook.
phone_verification: Confirmed independently from the business's own printed logo/business-card graphic used as their Booksy profile photo and logo image (biz_photo and logo assets on the Booksy venue page), which lists '1533-4 South Monroe St. Tallahassee, FL 32301' and '(850)666-0791' together. This matches the Booksy JSON-LD address exactly and is a business-published source (their own branding artwork), not a third-party directory. The Yellow Pages number (850) 656-2825 and address (111 S Magnolia Dr Ste 1) from prior discovery were NOT used since they could not be reconciled with this confirmed source. Booksy's page also exposes a distinct +1-206-735-3553 number in its booking widget, which carries a Seattle (206) area code inconsistent with the Tallahassee business and is almost certainly a Booksy call-tracking/proxy number, so it was not used either.
email_search: Checked: Instagram web_profile_info API (business_email, public_email fields both null), Booksy JSON-LD (no email field, no mailto on page), Facebook page (About section not accessible without login, no email visible in fetched content). No linktree/poplme in bio (external_url goes straight to Booksy). No email found through any channel; registering as null per pipeline rule.
brand_vibe: Logo wordmark is deep mocha brown 'Mocha' + bright pink/magenta 'Reign' script, tagline 'a natural hair & body Art studio' in warm taupe. Interior photos show white/cream walls, wood-look flooring, colorful eclectic decor (teal sofa, framed art). Site built on a light/cream base with a deep berry-rose accent and bright pink mid-accent to mirror the real logo colors, following the DESIGN.md palette structure (bg/surface/ink/accent-deep/accent-mid/accent-soft/accent-ghost).
